item.title: Árpád Szenti’s MERCULISTARYA Announces Debut Album “Áradó fájdalom a tűnődés medrében”
item.description: Hungarian Black Metal one-man band MERCULISTARYA announce its debut full-length album to be released on Pest Records and Metal Ör Die Records this February 20th. Titled “Áradó fájdalom a tűnődés medrében“, this is the deeply personal and emotional work of Árpád Szenti, known from his work in bands like Thy Catafalque, Ahriman, Athame or Damnation. “Áradó fájdalom a tűnődés medrében” is available for pre-order here: https://pestrecords.bandcamp.com/ As a […]

item.title: German Filthmongers PUTRIDARIUM Premiere Upcoming “Natvm Ad Mortem” EP Ahead of Release
item.description: Mystification Zine is hosting the exclusive premiere of PUTRIDARIUM’s upcoming EP “Natvm Ad Mortem”, giving listeners an early taste of the German band’s latest descent into filth-ridden death metal. item.title: SOUL GRINDER Release Video for Title Track of Current Album “Frozen Halls”
item.description: A few weeks ago, Frozen Halls, the new album by Northern German death metallers SOUL GRINDER, was released. Following “Malevolent Reality” (featuring Asenblut frontman Tetzel on guest vocals), the trio now unleash another video clip—this time for the album’s title track. item.title: WORSHIP THE SACRIFICE to Release New EP “Veil Of Revelations” on April 9th
item.description: Worship The Sacrifice return with VEIL OF REVELATIONS, a six-track EP out April 9th, 2026, defining the band’s “melo-chaotic death metal” sound in its clearest form to date. Leaning more heavily into melody while retaining their signature chaos, the EP balances ferocious speed, dynamic vocals, and strong melodic structure. item.title: Extreme Metal Act DANIELE BRUSASCHETTO Presents ‘Choking Clouds Of Ammonia’ Music Video
item.description: Daniele Brusaschetto presents “Choking Clouds Of Ammonia,” a track that traces the tension between daily pressure, creative urgency, and the need to stay grounded. The lyrics move through anxiety, routine, and a sharp sense of self-reflection, showing music as both a release and a driving force. item.title: JAGGED CITY Stream New Single ‘Ocean East, Ocean West’
item.description: Post-rock band Jagged City, featuring Jake Woodruff (Defeater) and Carlos Torres (former touring member of Explosions In The Sky) have unveiled their new single ‘Ocean East, Ocean West’. This is the second single taken from their debut EP, There Are More of Us, Always, to be released on 30th January via Pelagic Records. item.title: MAYHEM Drop New Single & Video ‘Life Is A Corpse You Drag’
item.description: The defining pioneers of black metal return with their seventh studio album, Liturgy of Death. item.title: THE BLACK DAHLIA MURDER Announce Spring Fling US Headlining Tour
